settings.official.title: 公式開発者認証
settings.official.hint: For Arenyxa official development and debugging capabilities. Sign-in requires an .aryxdev Developer Login Bundle, a matching local Developer Personal Key Vault, and a one-time private-key challenge. Only capabilities explicitly listed by the certificate are granted. This flow is independent from the public Developer Profile, Enterprise administrator authority, and Root Developer authority.

settings.root.title: Root Developer · 最高技術権限
settings.root.hint: For root developers performing highest-authority technical debugging only. This flow uses an independent Root Owner identity package and device key for strong authentication and continues to enforce the Root Integrity Challenge. It is not ordinary official-developer sign-in and is not inherited from Enterprise administrator authority.

about.privacy.title: ローカル優先とプライバシー境界
about.privacy.body:
• Core Arenyxa tasks, databases, search indexes, and settings are stored locally by default and do not require an Arenyxa cloud account.
• Core collection, parsing, search, export, and network analysis use local deterministic workflows.
• Target websites and explicitly enabled server/market/network-analysis features access the network as required; local-first does not mean never online.
• Sensitive values such as Cookie, Authorization, and Token are redacted by default at logging, diagnostic, and plugin boundaries.
about.license.title: オープンソースライセンスとリリース境界
about.license.note: Release signatures verify source and integrity. They do not restrict source modification and are not license activation, online activation, or hardware binding.
